title: Permission Policy
description: A permission policy in the auth system. Policies are data, not code — adding a new permission is adding a row, not writing a conditional. The contract is (subject, resource, action) -> effect where resource and action are extensible types, not hardcoded enums. If a new category of permission emerges, it should be expressible within this model by defining new resource types and action types — not by changing the model itself. Source: auth-spec.md.

id.description: Unique identifier for this policy rule. Generated by the system. Used for management operations (grant, revoke, list).

subject.description: The identity this policy applies to: an exact identity ID, '*' for every identity, or 'type:<actor_type>' for every identity of that type. Unknown identity references remain dormant and grant nothing.
subject.$comment: Cross-references identity.json via the id field

resource.description: What this policy controls access to. Matching is exact, '*' (any resource), or a trailing '/*' segment prefix such as 'memory:/life/*'. Arbitrary mid-string wildcards are not portable. Resource types remain extensible.

action.description: What operation this policy permits or denies. Matching is exact or '*' (any action); action types remain extensible.

effect.description: Whether this policy allows or denies the action. If multiple matching rules apply, any matching deny wins over every allow; otherwise a matching allow permits the action. The owner has the default allow-all policy on their own system; other identities start with no access until granted.

conditions.description: Optional portable constraints. Every supplied condition must be satisfied for the rule to match. Unknown condition names make the rule unsupported and it must not grant access. `requires_approval` is decision metadata enforced by Auth, not a condition that changes matching.

requires_approval.description: If true on a matching allow, Auth must require the product's approval flow before execution.

max_per_day.description: Maximum number of matching allowed operations in the owner's calendar day; Auth must count and enforce it.

time_window.description: Inclusive wall-clock window; timezone is explicit when omitted from the deployment default. Overnight windows are evaluated across midnight.

created.description: When this policy was created (ISO 8601). Included for audit trail.

created_by.description: Identity ID of who created this policy. References identity.json. Owner or delegator.
created_by.$comment: Cross-references identity.json via the id field
